summary: Implemented rule E3695 to validate ElastiCache cache cluster engines. Added src/cfnlint/rules/resources/elasticache/CacheClusterEngine.py (CfnLintJsonSchema rule targeting AWS::ElastiCache::CacheCluster Engine), a new enum schema at src/cfnlint/data/schemas/extensions/aws_elasticache_cachecluster/engine_enum.json (memcached, redis, valkey), and a docs/rules.md row for E3695. Nothing was run or tested, and no commit was made. Unverified choice: the valkey value is included without checking the current CloudFormation spec; remove it if the spec lists only memcached and redis. No unit tests or snapshot templates were added.
